House Window Tinting
Is window tinting worth it for a house?

Yes — a family home runs the A/C harder than almost any building because living rooms and bedrooms sit behind big street-facing and west-facing windows all day. Quality film cuts that heat by up to 10°C, lowers your monthly A/C bill, stops furniture and floors fading under UV, and gives daytime privacy from the street — all while keeping the glass clear.
How much does house window tinting cost in Thailand?

Installed film runs from ฿70/sq ft for carbon film up to ฿180/sq ft for premium sputtering. Most whole-house projects fall between ฿12,000 and ฿40,000, depending on total glass area, window height and film tier. The exact figure is confirmed free during your on-site measurement.
Can you see through house window film at night?

Daytime-privacy film works by reflecting the brighter side. In daylight, people on the street can't see in while you keep your view out. At night — when interior lights are on and it's darker outside — that reverses, so for bedrooms and street-facing living rooms we recommend pairing film with curtains or blinds, or choosing a higher-privacy tier. We advise the right film per room during measurement.
How effective is house window film against heat?

Premium ceramic and sputtering films reject the majority of heat and 99% of UV, lowering indoor temperatures by up to 10°C and cutting A/C load 20–30%. For a house that's a measurable drop in your monthly electricity bill, especially in west-facing living rooms and upstairs bedrooms that trap afternoon heat.
Will window film stop my furniture and floors fading?

Yes. Sofas, wooden and laminate floors, curtains, rugs and artwork fade quickly under tropical UV. Our film blocks 99% of ultraviolet light, dramatically slowing fade and protecting the interiors you paid for, without darkening the room or hiding the view.
Do you install house window film on-site across Thailand?

Yes. JaiDeeClear is a fully mobile service — certified technicians come to your house in Phuket, Bangkok, Chonburi and beyond. No glass is removed and there's no workshop visit. Free on-site measurement is included with every quote.
